primitives.name: Tool availability validation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Ensure all links for tools like LiveGenic and Hover are active and ready.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes continuous network connectivity and functional API endpoints.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when any tool link returns a non-200 HTTP status code.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE system health monitoring where tool uptime is a critical state variable.

primitives.name: Initial homeowner contact
primitives.verbatim_quote: Initial Contact (Day 2): Place a call to introduce yourself, confirm the inspection time, and provide an overview of how the program works.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes the homeowner is present and receptive to information.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down if the homeowner does not answer within three attempts.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI caller-signal analysis where contact success is modeled as a Bernoulli trial.
layer2.telemetry: Contact completion rate per inspection day.

primitives.name: Photo upload and submission

primitives.assumptions: Assumes stable internet connection and file size limits do not exceed platform thresholds.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if the upload timeout exceeds 10 minutes or if file corruption is detected.

layer2.telemetry: Upload success ratio and average transfer time in seconds.
